_comment: pgvector: semantic similarity store for deep-research. Stores vector embeddings of paper abstracts and summaries. Enables semantic search: finding papers conceptually similar to a query, clustering papers by topic, and hybrid queries combining graph traversal with embedding similarity. Not in base because it is specific to knowledge persistence workflows.
_docker_image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 — see scripts/setup-env.js for Docker Compose setup

_schema.columns: id, paper_id, title, abstract_embedding VECTOR(1536), summary_embedding VECTOR(1536), created_at, updated_at
_schema.index: IVFFlat cosine distance index on abstract_embedding and summary_embedding
